Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the governor's signature on significant legislative rules.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the governor's signature on significantlegislative rules; and amending RCW 34.05.360.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 34.05.360 and 1988 c 288 s 311 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The order of adoption by which each rule is adopted by an agencyshall contain all of the following: (1) The date the agency adopted the rule; (2) A concise statement of the purpose of the rule; (3) A reference to all rules repealed, amended, or suspended by therule; (4) A reference to the specific statutory or other authorityauthorizing adoption of the rule; (5) Any findings required by any provision of law as a preconditionto adoption or effectiveness of the rule; ((and)) (6) If the rule qualifies as a significant legislative rule of anagency that is under the authority of the governor, the signature ofthe governor; and p. 1 HB 1276 (7) The effective date of the rule if other than that specified inRCW 34.05.380(2).
